projects.title: NostrMind
projects.description: Config-driven Nostr monitoring worker with AI classification and optional DM alerts. Integrating LLM reasoning into decentralized protocols.
projects.challenge: Nostr has no built-in intelligence layer — signals, alerts, and content moderation are manual or nonexistent.
projects.outcome: Config-driven worker that monitors Nostr relays, classifies content via LLM reasoning, and optionally sends DM alerts based on custom rules.
results: LLM-powered content classification on Nostr events
Config-driven rules — no code changes needed
DM alert system for real-time notifications
Experimental proof that AI + decentralized protocols work together
